system.description:
Touch; one object or a 10ft cube per level. Choose a kind of creature (a species, or an alignment); that kind within 30ft must make a Will save each round or be Frightened and move away; the effect lasts 1 hour per level. A creature that succeeds is immune for 24 hours. Cast reversed (Sympathy): the chosen kind within 60ft must make a Will save or be drawn to the spot and stay within 10ft of it (no attacks on the object); Will negates.

Reversible: may be cast as its opposite with the same slot.

Classes: Wizard, Cleric, Druid, Witch
